item.text:
Built the Next.js reading library. You can add books, mark them finished, edit notes, and share individual book pages. The starter shelf contains labeled sample books you can remove.

Run it with `npm run dev` and open http://localhost:3000. Books are saved in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json); sharing links with others requires hosting the app at an accessible URL with persistent writable storage.

The production build passed, and I verified adding, updating, finishing, deleting, and retaining a book across a restart. Setup details are in [README.md](/workspace/README.md).
